name: z-stack
description: Zcash wallet engine and browser SDK

scripts.test: node --conditions=@z-stack/source --import tsx --test scripts/release-versions.test.mjs scripts/regtest-rpc.test.mjs scripts/regtest-container.test.mjs scripts/create-example.test.mjs scripts/check-testnet-chain.test.mjs scripts/check-patches.test.mjs scripts/example-lifetime.test.mjs scripts/example-wallet-view.test.mjs scripts/grpc-web-proxy.test.mjs packages/passkey/test/vault.test.ts packages/sdk/test/grpc-web.test.ts packages/sdk/test/diagnostics.test.ts packages/sdk/test/public-data.test.ts packages/core/test/core.test.ts packages/sdk/test/browser-wallet.test.ts packages/sdk/test/engine.test.ts packages/sdk/test/integrity.test.ts packages/sdk/test/loading.test.ts packages/sdk/test/lifecycle.test.ts packages/sdk/test/lifecycle-review.test.ts packages/sdk/test/harness.test.ts packages/sdk/test/worker-artifacts.test.ts packages/sdk/test/storage.test.ts packages/sdk/test/prefetch.test.ts packages/sdk/test/subtree-roots.test.ts packages/sdk/test/wasm.test.ts packages/sdk/test/passkey.test.ts packages/sdk/test/hardware.test.ts packages/sdk/test/package-exports.test.ts packages/sdk/test/setup-diagnostics.test.ts packages/sdk/test/adapter-conformance.test.ts && pnpm test:base
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @z-stack/core build && pnpm --filter @z-stack/passkey build && pnpm --filter @z-stack/sdk build && pnpm --filter @z-stack/base build
scripts.build:sdk: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:wasm:mt && pnpm build:packages
scripts.check:packages: pnpm --filter @z-stack/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @z-stack/passkey typecheck && pnpm --filter @z-stack/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @z-stack/base typecheck
scripts.release:check: pnpm check:licenses && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:patches && pnpm check:packages && pnpm docs:api && pnpm test && pnpm test:packages && pnpm test:base:package && pnpm test:combined:package
